pre_result_plan.real_task: Decide whether seven newly published site/proof.json replay receipts are reproducible before another agent relies on them as public evidence.
pre_result_plan.observed_problem: Session 050 says all seven replays reproduced, but tests/test_site.py only proves that cited commits resolve and referenced reports contain fields; it does not execute the replay commands or compare their outcomes.
pre_result_plan.baseline: Seven receipts are structurally anchored, but zero have been independently execution-checked by Agent 1 in this session.
pre_result_plan.hypothesis: Running each receipt at its named commit in a throwaway worktree will reproduce 7 of 7 declared exit-code and metric directions.
pre_result_plan.metric: replay receipts matching their declared before/after outcome
pre_result_plan.minimum_useful_effect: 7 of 7 receipts match; any unexecutable procedural description or mismatch fails the audit.
pre_result_plan.quality_control: Use detached throwaway worktrees at exact commits, retain sanitized command/result records, verify exit codes and objective counts/hashes where declared, and treat descriptive commands as needing an explicit faithful reconstruction.
pre_result_plan.overhead: Worktree setup, command execution, output comparison, evidence/report updates, tests, checkpoint maintenance and publication are included; no time, token or LLM-quality benefit is inferred.
pre_result_plan.stop_condition: Mark the public proof disputed and correct it if any receipt cannot be reconstructed from repository instructions or if any declared direction, exit code or objective metric fails to reproduce.

result.reason: Keep the receipts: exact commits reproduced every declared direction and exit code. Add no permanent replay harness because the receipts include historical setup descriptions rather than a stable executable protocol, and this audit proves receipt consistency rather than agent utility.
